about_the_game:
Jellyfish Egg is a dark fantasy RPG focused on exploration, narration, and non-combat skill progression. Each run begins as a child in a procedurally generated world. As you grow older, your actions age your body and shape your skills, relationships, and aspirations. There are no saves, no retries—only a single life per journey.

Create a unique character using six core attributes, each influencing what skills you can learn, which companions you can befriend, and how long you’ll survive. The world itself is generated as a navigable sphere, featuring a wide variety of locations—forests, cities, mountain peaks, plains, coasts, and open seas—each with their own traversal challenges and opportunities for discovery.

Instead of combat, progress is made through skill checks that combine your own abilities, those of your companions, and the tools you carry. With over 300 possible non-combat skills to discover—ranging from poetry and stonework to stealth and medicine—your story unfolds through the choices you make and the paths you follow.

Narration is handled dynamically by a local language model (phi-3.5) running entirely on your machine. As you act, the game generates poetic, low-fantasy prose to describe your journey in real time, making every playthrough feel like a myth being written as you live it.

Whether you follow your character’s mysterious visions or forge your own path, Jellyfish Egg offers a singular experience shaped by curiosity, skill, and consequence.

Key Features

  • Custom Character Creation – Shape your destiny using six core attributes (Constitution, Dexterity, Intelligence, Imagination, Charisma, Willpower), each affecting skills, companions, vitality, and your path through the world

  • Deep Skill-Based Progression – Discover and level over 300 non-combat skills such as stonework, patience, charm, poetry, stealth, astronomy, medicine, foreseeing, and impersonation, each with unique uses in the world

  • Procedural Spherical World – Each run creates a unique navigable globe filled with cities, ruins, seas, and secrets

  • Single-Life Structure – No saves, no reloading; every action matters, and time always moves forward

  • Narration by LLM – A local language model transforms your actions into dynamic story text in real time

  • Lore-Rich Setting – A world where stars are jellyfish, emotions are liquid, some numbers are green and ancient empires have collapsed into myth

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i9
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GPU with 2GB+ VRAM (CUDA supported)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: CUDA installed. Uses GPU for LLM inference.

short_description: A dark fantasy RPG with procedural spherical worlds, dynamic narration, and rich roleplay possibilities. Create unique characters, grow from childhood to old age, master hundreds of skills. Become a poet or a knight, a judge or an assassin, an astronomer or a peasant, or someone entirely your own.
